thought.text: The form fields look fine but maybe the login POSTs to a different URL. Let me check the form's action attribute.

reasoning_content: The response only differs by CSRF token. Let me check the form action URL — the login might POST to a different endpoint (login.pl) rather than index.pl. Let me look at the form in the HTML.

action.command: cd /tmp && grep -oE '<form[^>]*>' qisutu-index.html; echo '---'; grep -oE 'action="[^"]*"' qisutu-index.html | head -5

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && grep -oE '<form[^>]*>' qisutu-index.html; echo '---'; grep -oE 'action=\"[^\"]*\"' qisutu-index.html | head -5", "summary": "Check login form action URL", "security_risk": "LOW"}
